scientific_question: Does observed butterfly larval-resource homogenization remain above matched null expectation after adding BCE/Clarke evidence-1–3 published host records, when each butterfly's introduced-only resource additions within each WGSRPD Level1 group are also conserved?

scenarios: one-direction BCE/Clarke accepted-ID additions for same 81 known European butterfly species, other 158 focal butterflies unchanged
design.same_domain: The 355 native-active WGSRPD3 region codes from the ORIGINAL HOSTS scenario; retain EXACTLY these codes in BOTH comparisons; report new BCE native-active region separately without using it for the paired analysis
design.identical_null: Reproduce the original scripts/analyze_butterfly_resource_homogenization_level1_null.py within-Level1 two-edge swaps, including burn=max(10000,15*added_edges), spacing=max(2000,3*added_edges), same eligible group sampling rule and native exclusion.
preserve: Original scenario-specific native resource-incidence cells as forbidden placements
statistic: mean Jaccard between regional sets of butterfly potential larval-host opportunities
reject_if: Original 239 source panel 26,530 native / 41,083 contemporary / 14,553 added resources not reproduced
Original 355-region baseline Jaccard metrics differ from frozen receipt
Any Level3 region missing Level1 mapping
Native not subset contemporary, any null randomization changes per-species-by-Level1, per-region or per-butterfly margins
Source crosswalk 1027 links in 679 accepted taxa fails

interpretation.decision: Record sign, effect-size and Monte Carlo p of excess, even if negative or not distinguishable from null. No tuning or deleting butterfly families to rescue an effect.
interpretation.limited_scope: Post-hoc European host-source augmentation, original fixed 355 region domain, source-specific Level1 conditional structure, not corrected global biodiversity estimate.
no_claims: observed native or invasive butterfly colonization
interpretation.manuscript: Do not edit submission PR #38 before evaluation
